prompt: deep fusion hierarchical foam: Voronoi walls with BCC lattice inside each cell
limitations: Interior lattice fragments that do not touch a wall are kept; the single-solid check decides whether they count.

Fused designs use manifold dual contouring with vertex splitting at pinches; at the measured resolutions (96, 128) no non-manifold edges remain (docs/NONMANIFOLD.md). Other resolutions are not guaranteed to be free of pinches.
No exact B-Rep for this design: STL/glTF come from surface nets of the SDF; STEP export is unavailable.
SDF surface resolution is limited to h = 0.0781 mm (constraints.resolution = 256); features below ~2h are not resolved.
Genus is the first Betti number of the voxel solid (independent handles); it depends on the grid resolution.
Connectivity counts components of at least 27 grid nodes; smaller slivers are reported in observations and not repaired.

min_wall_thickness = 5th percentile of inward-ray chords (absolute minimum reported separately); entry/exit error about ±h/2 = ±0.039 mm; 0 sub-voxel chords discarded. Not a certified manufacturing check.
Repair is capped at 5 rounds and runs one parameter change per round (greedy, no search).
Repairs act on the SDF/B-Rep parameters; they do not change the code structure (priority 3 is not automated).
unknowns: Resolution above 160 per axis may exceed browser memory budgets.
